topic: Single source of truth for readiness
options: A: keep every desk separate; B: designate one versioned requirements register and map every legacy row; C: delete older registers.
recommended_path: B: use the 78-row decision-readiness register as the primary navigation target for this hub, map the 72-row e46 register before merging, and retain older pages as linked archives.
what_would_change_the_recommendation: A verified row-by-row crosswalk with no dropped or silently changed requirement would permit a single combined dataset.
decision_status: PROPOSED; no other session data modified

options: A: license a timestamped feed; B: capture one named operator only after terms and permission are verified; C: publish no price-relative score until a permitted source exists.
recommended_path: C now; evaluate A or B only after source terms, jurisdiction, timestamp semantics and settlement rules are written down. Keep market-open and market-close blank meanwhile.
what_would_change_the_recommendation: A signed source/terms record and test captures with a bookmaker, timestamp, market ID, price, rules and repeatable retrieval would change the recommendation.

options: A: retain daily public copies; B: retain raw captures in a private store and publish permitted derivatives; C: keep one weekly snapshot.
recommended_path: B: capture the official injury report at each publication time, record timestamp/hash/conflicts in a private immutable store, and publish only authorized deltas. Do not treat a scheduled fetch as an archive unless the artifact is retained.
what_would_change_the_recommendation: Source terms permitting the retained fields and a successful replay of a known Questionable-to-Out change would support public-derived publication.

options: A: ingest Game Books now; B: obtain written permission or another authorized feed; C: infer starters from depth charts.
recommended_path: B. Reject C. The official PDF states that uses outside its media-coverage purpose require written permission; do not ingest or publish player-level Game Book data until authorized.
what_would_change_the_recommendation: Written permission, a license, or an official source whose terms expressly allow this use would reopen ingestion.
decision_status: PROPOSED; raw Game Book rows intentionally not copied

options: A: trust the depth chart as a single starter list; B: verify official club charts and preserve grouped/empty slots; C: use an authorized official snap-count proxy where a club chart cannot be structured.
recommended_path: B, then C only if an official, permitted snap source is verified for every club. Keep Houston image rows blank; never transcribe by eye or infer rank from jersey, experience or salary.
what_would_change_the_recommendation: A source-by-source audit covering every club and position, with retained source dates and explicit conflicts, would clear the coverage gate.

options: A: display backtest scores as provisional ranks; B: keep backtests in research/audit only and qualify on prospective proper-score evidence before any staking panel; C: rank only by season ROI.
recommended_path: B. Remove all historical result numbers from public leaderboards; first qualify singles by benchmark-relative proper score with game-cluster uncertainty and a multiple-testing adjustment, then escrow CLV/ROI separately on a prospective window. Keep parlay/prop-combo divisions locked until direct joint validation and settlement rules exist.
what_would_change_the_recommendation: A future preregistered prospective sample passing the frozen score, uncertainty, multiplicity, price and replication gates would permit a rank; a failed demotion gate returns the strategy to paper.
decision_status: PROPOSED; safe hub leaderboard contains no performance figures

topic: Official schedule announcement next to live schedule
options: A: link only the current weekly schedule; B: pair the dated league announcement and the live schedule; C: copy schedule facts without versioning.
recommended_path: B. This hub now links the May 8 league announcement beside the live Week 11 schedule; add the same source pair to the canonical schedule-announcement dataset when its owner can integrate it.
what_would_change_the_recommendation: A future dated schedule revision with a matching official release would be appended as a new version, not overwrite the old announcement.
decision_status: HUB IMPLEMENTED; canonical dataset sync pending

topic: Public analysis and private raw store
options: A: keep every raw row in the static site; B: hold raw snapshots privately and expose only permitted aggregates, derived analysis and official links; C: stop all historical work.
recommended_path: B, after source-term and retention review. Do not publish raw Game Book content; do not claim a private store exists until a storage backend and access policy are implemented.
what_would_change_the_recommendation: A source-by-source rights matrix and access-controlled archive with a deletion/retention policy would support deployment.
decision_status: PROPOSED; this hub contains no raw player-level rows

options: A: take the location from the week page; B: read the venue from each linked Game Center; C: infer a venue from the club or city.
recommended_path: B. The user explicitly requested Game Center provenance; keep a venue blank until that fixture's Game Center confirms it, and retain the source URL per row.
what_would_change_the_recommendation: Every fixture in the published slate has a matching Game Center URL and a verified venue field.
decision_status: PROPOSED; one source example is linked

options: A: map Questionable to a fixed percentage; B: treat the designation as a surprise feature and calibrate it against official game-day status/participation; C: exclude it permanently.
recommended_path: B only after a multi-season official join with confidence intervals; until then keep the label out of the model and retain levels/deltas only as descriptive evidence.
what_would_change_the_recommendation: A validated, season-held-out reliability estimate with its sample size and interval, joined to a permitted official inactive/participation source.
decision_status: PROPOSED; no fixed injury penalty applied by this hub
